id: title:dmarchuk:wrap overview metric cards like the metrics tab

review.posthog_relevance: Changes responsive behavior and layout constraints of Workflow Overview metric cards, potentially affecting display and wrapping on smaller screens.
review.reason: Replaces grid-based layout with flex-wrap and removes explicit min-width constraints, allowing metric cards to wrap naturally. This is a localized, bounded UI behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the previous grid implementation caused layout issues or if the new flex behavior is preferred; no test results or user reports are provided. No tier score assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file frontend change. No tier score assigned. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced grid-based layout with flex-wrap and added a data attribute; removed explicit min-width class.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the responsive behavior of the Workflow Overview metric cards, potentially affecting how they wrap and display on smaller screens. The added data attribute could support future accessibility or testing selectors.

observations.behavior: Removed the min-width class from WorkflowMetricCard components, relying on the parent's flex-wrap behavior instead.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a constraint that could have caused horizontal scrolling or fixed-width behavior, allowing the card to shrink and wrap naturally with the parent flex container.
